SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT) AS "orders.iso_dow",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT)
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.iso_dow",
  _base."orders.revenue",
  _base."orders.revenue" / _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by."orders.amount_sum_partition_by" AS "orders.share"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.iso_dow" ASC
LIMIT 21
